description: Source code implementing LE Audio services functions, including data parsing, security checks, and GATT attribute read/write handlers.

methods.name: bt_audio_data_parse
methods.description: Parses a list of attribute-value pairs from a byte array, applying a callback function to each data item.

methods.name: bt_audio_security_check
methods.description: Checks security requirements for a Bluetooth connection, including encryption and security flags.

methods.name: bt_audio_read_chrc
methods.description: Handles reading a GATT characteristic with security checks.

methods.name: bt_audio_write_chrc
methods.description: Handles writing to a GATT characteristic with security checks.

methods.name: bt_audio_ccc_cfg_write
methods.description: Handles writing to a Client Characteristic Configuration descriptor with security checks.
